title: Protocol for auxin-inducible depletion of the RNA-binding protein PTBP1 in mouse embryonic stem cells
protocol: Generate a CRISPR-Cas9 construct using an appropriate gRNA design tool.
Insert the gRNA-encoding oligonucleotide duplex into pX330 plasmid cut with BbsI.
Modify the knock-in strategy for N-terminal tagging if necessary.
Generate HDR constructs for in-frame C-terminal mAID tagging of your gene of interest with 2 different markers.
Amplify Ptbp1-specific left homology arm from mouse genomic DNA using Ptbp1_HAL_F/Ptbp1_HAL_R primer pairs.
Amplify Ptbp1-specific right homology arm from mouse genomic DNA using Ptbp1_HAR_F/Ptbp1_HAR_R primer pairs.
Clone the left and right arms into pML42 vector at SacI-BamHI and BstBI-AvrII sites, respectively, to produce the pML58 HDR construct.
Clone the left and right arms into pML49 vector at SacI-BamHI and BstBI-AvrII sites, respectively, to produce the pML60 HDR construct.
Replace HygR in pML58 with a BSD-containing fragment amplified from pLenti6-LacZ using BSD_F/BSD_R primer pairs, producing the pML646 HDR construct.
Grow TRE-OsTIR1 cells in 2i+LIF with 100 μg/mL of G418 as described for OsTIR1 transgene integration into A2lox ESC genome.
Trypsinize the culture on the day of transfection to detach cells.
Quench trypsin and count cells using a hemocytometer.
Transfect 0.75–1×106 cells with a mixture containing 500 ng each of a CRISPR-Cas9 construct, HygR- and BSD-containing HDR constructs, 3 μL of Lipofectamine 2000, and 100 μL of Opti-MEM I.
Incubate the transfected cells for 2 h in 6-cm bacterial dishes.
Collect the cells by centrifugation for 5 min at 200 × g.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of 2i+LIF.
Plate duplicated 100, 200, and 500 μL aliquots to individual wells of a gelatin-coated 6-well TC plate with final volume of 2 mL of 2i+LIF supplemented with 0.5 μM Alt-R HDR Enhancer V2.
Replace the medium after 24–48 h in a TC incubator with 2 mL/well of 2i+LIF containing 150 μg/mL hygromycin B and 8 μg/mL blasticidin S.
Propagate the cells for an additional 10–15 days with regular medium changes every 1–3 days.
Pick and dissociate the colonies as described in the relevant section.
Transfer the entire volume to a gelatinized TC-grade flat-bottom 96-well plate containing 200 μL of 2i+LIF with 2% FBS and 150 μg/mL of hygromycin B and 8 μg/mL of blasticidin S per well.
Add 1% of FBS to the medium 4–5 days prior to colony picking if necessary.
Change the medium to 2i+LIF without FBS and with 100 μg/mL of hygromycin B and 5 μg/mL of blasticidin S per well when colonies are ready.
Trypsinize the cells when the wells reach 60%–70% confluence.
Quench with 200 μL of 2i+LIF with 2% FBS.
Transfer half of the volume to a fresh gelatinized TC-grade flat-bottom 96-well plate containing 100 μL of 2i+LIF with 2% FBS and 100 μg/mL of hygromycin B and 5 μg/mL of blasticidin S per well.
Centrifuge the 96-well plate with remaining half of trypsinized cells from step 12 of the previous section using a 96-well plate rotor at 1500 × g for 10 min.
Remove the supernatants using a multichannel pipette.
Transfer cell suspensions to 96-well PCR plates prior to centrifugation.
Extract DNA from the cell pellets using PCRBIO Rapid Extract PCR Kit, as recommended by the manufacturer.
Resuspend the cell pellets in a smaller volume of final PCRBIO Rapid Extract mix (down to 30–40 μL).
Incubate the plate for 5 min at 75°C.
Incubate the plate for 10 min at 95°C.
Genotype DNA samples by multiplex PCR designed to amplify both wild-type and knock-in alleles.
Analyze PCR products by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Select clones with robust amplification of the knock-in specific fragment and lacking the endogenous wild-type specific product for expansion.
Plate 0.5–1×10^5 cells from each expanded clone per well of a 12-well plate in 1 mL of 2i+LIF supplemented with 1 μg/mL of Dox and 0.5 mM indole-3-acetic acid (IAA).
Grow the cells for 24 hours.
Collect the cells after growth.
Analyze levels of protein of interest by immunoblotting with antibodies against the mAID-tagged protein.
Use TRE-OsTIR1 and mAID-tagged cells treated with DMSO as negative controls.
Use TRE-OsTIR1 and mAID-tagged cells treated with Dox or IAA only as negative controls.
Optimize the concentration of IAA within the 0.1–0.5 mM range if cytotoxicity is an issue.
Pre-induce OsTIR1 expression in 12-well cultures with 1 μg/mL of Dox for 16–24 hours.
Supplement wells with 0.5 mM IAA to trigger mAID-tagged protein degradation after pre-induction.
Reduce PTBP-mAID protein abundance to <10% of its original level by treating Dox-preinduced cultures with IAA for 4-6 hours.
